params.notes: InpProfit=80 pips total basket profit; only active when enable_profit=true

other_exits: Time-based close: all positions closed when hour >= 23 (end of day)
Basket loss close: when enable_loss=true and totalprofit <= -InpLoss (40 pips), close all
Emergency doubling: when totalprofit <= -emergency_loss (60 pips), DoublePositions() doubles winning positions, then disables further emergency trading

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Emergency doubling copies volume from existing winning position (m_position.Volume())

custom_logic_notes: Multi-symbol hedge basket EA. Opens 4 positions simultaneously: when d_c11>0 (Symbol1 had positive prior-day deviation), buys EURUSD+USDCHF+AUDUSD and sells GBPUSD. When d_c11<0, sells EURUSD+USDCHF+AUDUSD and buys GBPUSD. Each symbol has a separate magic number. Entry only between hour 0 minute 5 and minute 12. All positions closed at hour>=23. Emergency doubling logic: when basket loss exceeds emergency_loss (60 pips), winning positions are doubled (same direction, same volume) with emergency magic number. The DoublePositions symbol filter has a logical bug: 'symbol!=InpSymbol_1 || symbol!=InpSymbol_2 || ...' is always true (should be &&), so it continues on all symbols. Profit is calculated per-symbol in pips using point values. The iClose() helper uses CopyClose(). IsTradeAllowed() has a duplicate check (TERMINAL_TRADE_ALLOWED checked twice). Time filter allows entry only in a 7-minute window at start of day.
python_conversion_notes: Multi-symbol coordination is the primary challenge. Need to: (1) track 4 positions as a basket with individual magic numbers, (2) implement the D1 deviation calculation using prior-day close ratios, (3) replicate the emergency doubling logic with position-level profit tracking, (4) handle the time-based entry window (0:05-0:12) and exit window (>=23:00), (5) note the logical bug in DoublePositions symbol filter (|| should be &&), (6) the filling type auto-detection (FOK/IOC/RETURN) should map to broker-specific settings, (7) profit calculation is in integer pips (cast to int) which truncates fractional pips, (8) no SL/TP on individual orders - exits are basket-level only
